importRules.description: CMS adapter internals (transport, config, preview, shape quirks) are private to lib/cms — everything else goes through the lib/cms public API or lib/content
components/ render normalized content via lib/content + types/contentful.ts; they must never reach into lib/cms
lib/cache knows nothing about any CMS except the neutral PurgeTargets type in lib/cms/types

invariants.description: Full SSR, CDN-cached: a Next-side cache cannot be purged by CDN tag purges and silently serves stale content
invariants.message: "use cache" is forbidden — caching happens at the CDN, purged by tags. See AGENTS.md core invariants.

invariants.description: Next data-layer caching bypasses CDN tag purges
invariants.message: unstable_cache is forbidden — it cannot be purged by CDN tag purges. See AGENTS.md core invariants.

invariants.description: fetch() next.revalidate / next.tags create an unpurgeable Next-side cache
invariants.message: fetch next:{revalidate|tags} is forbidden — CMS fetches use cache: "no-store"; the CDN owns caching. See AGENTS.md core invariants.

invariants.description: ISR route segment config conflicts with the CDN-owned caching model
invariants.message: export const revalidate (ISR) is forbidden — responses are CDN-cached and tag-purged. See AGENTS.md core invariants.

invariants.description: proxy.ts stays fast: no data fetching in it, ever
invariants.message: No data fetching in proxy.ts — the full-URL lookup strategy exists precisely to avoid this. See AGENTS.md core invariants.

invariants.description: No heavy CMS SDKs — the GraphQL client is a native-fetch POST with retry/backoff
invariants.message: Importing a Contentful SDK is forbidden — use the native-fetch client in lib/cms. See AGENTS.md core invariants.
